Effective January 8, 2021, thresholds are announced annually on the FRA website. Removal of numeric amounts from 225.19 does not create a zero threshold.
2026 threshold $12,600 and $200 increase over 2025 imply $12,400 for 2025. Explicit inference; original 2025 notice not separately recovered.
US DOT research table 5 records 2021 $11,200 and 2023 $11,500. Original annual notices remain a source-review residual.
Monthly reports due within 30 days after month-end. Source note 75 FR 68905, November 9, 2010 predates all cases.
Immediate triggers independently screened against authored fatality, injury, passenger and property facts; last-amendment source note is 2010.
Federal petroleum water-sheen reporting is not a generic gallon threshold. State/local duties remain independent.

event_year_authority_boundary: Annual 225.19 editions retained with exact hashes. The 2018 threshold and 2020 method rules were read. Current 225.9/225.11 source notes identify last amendments in 2010, before all cases. Historical eCFR date pages failed and API returned 406; precise event-day amendment reconciliation remains a qualified legal-review residual, separate from fictional performance. Apply reproduced annual criteria to expressly authored facts.
